intro: Call of Water is an elemental quest requiring a journey from Loch Modan to Westfall to restore balance to a corrupted spring. By purging the tainted entity at Stendel's Pond and performing an ancient ritual at the forgotten shrine, petitioners earn the favor of the water spirits and their Water Totem.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In Westfall, outside o' Moonbrook lies Stendel's Pond. Once a pure spring, now touched by dark forces. The spirits there 'ave gone silent.

Ye must face the corruption that fouls the waters. Take its bracers and the last drops o' Hervdana's potion, then place 'em on the shrine. That'll call forth a spirit, cleansed and true. Speak with it, learn what ye can.
Bring me proof the deed's done, and I'll grant ye the totem.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The shrine stands aged and forgotten, cloaked in dust and cobwebs. The pond beside it lies eerily still, its surface untouched by wind or life. Scattered along the shore are the bones of beasts once burdened by labor. The water's murky sheen raises a troubling question--has it been poisoned by the surrounding malaise, or is it the very source of it?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You place the bracers atop the shrine and then pour the remaining drops of Norric's potion into dry stone. You begin to incant the simple words Norric taught you and the droplets vaporize atop the stone within the bindings....
